mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. I’m so glad you’re here, ready to dive into a story that pulses with the restless search for identity—a journey where the raw, electric energy of music gets tangled up with the questions of who we really are. Picture the Pacific Northwest’s punk and indie rock scene: a place bursting with creativity, where the hunger to belong and the urge to break away are constantly at odds. That’s the world of Hunger Makes Me a Modern Girl, brought to life by Carrie Brownstein. Together, we’ll explore the turbulence of growing up, the ache of feeling out of place, and how powerful creative expression can be when life feels overwhelming. You’ll find yourself right there as Sleater-Kinney comes together, and as Carrie carves out her own fiercely independent path. We’ll feel the tension between being vulnerable and staying strong; we’ll see what it means to fight to be seen and heard in a world that doesn’t always welcome what’s different. Through every twist of triumph and struggle, we’ll witness how art, friendship, and the courage to face your own hunger for meaning can lead to something truly genuine—a spark of connection and authenticity. So, let’s set out on this journey together, ready to discover what happens when you refuse to settle for anything less than your most honest self.
